wages.text: Garcia states that he supports raising wages for working families.
wages.quote: Congressman Garcia's stance on raising wages for working families

trade.text: Garcia opposed President Trump’s tariffs, saying they raised prices and that costs should be brought down for families.
trade.quote: The Supreme Court has made it clear that these tariffs are illegal and harming consumers. It’s time to move forward and bring costs down for families.

debt.text: Garcia said he would protect and expand eligibility and benefits for Medicaid, Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: In Congress, I will fight to protect and expand eligibility and benefits for Medicaid, Social Security and Medicare.

housing.text: Garcia supports creating more homes, especially near transit corridors and job centers, and removing zoning barriers to construction.
housing.quote: He knows it’s critical for us to invest in not only shelter, but supportive services and permanent housing for people who are unhoused. Congressman Garcia also believes we must redouble efforts to assist residents who are housing insecure. This is a long-term, structural problem and it requires us to take bold steps to create the new homes our community needs—especially along our transit corridors and job centers.

safety.text: Garcia called for federal support for mental-health and violence-diversion programs in communities and schools.
safety.quote: Communities and schools must also receive federal support for expanded mental health programs and violence diversion programs.

immigration.text: Garcia supports creating pathways to citizenship for undocumented residents and opposing discrimination against immigrants.
immigration.quote: Congressman Garcia knows first-hand how important it is for us to support immigrant communities and create pathways to citizenship for undocumented residents.

guns.text: Garcia supports universal background checks, bans on assault-style weapons, federal licensing, and other gun restrictions.
guns.quote: He believes Congress needs to come together and pass legislation that mandates universal background checks for all firearm purchases, bans assault-style weapons, prohibits gun ownership by those under the age of 21 and establishes a strong federal licensing system.

abortion.text: Garcia describes abortion access as a critical part of health care and supports defending the right to abortion.
abortion.quote: Congressman Garcia's belief that abortion access is a critical part of healthcare.

cannabis.text: As mayor, Garcia oversaw legalization and taxation of cannabis while promoting social equity.
cannabis.quote: legalized and taxed cannabis while promoting social equity

health.text: Garcia said he supports Medicare for All and that health coverage should not depend on employment.
health.quote: I believe the best approach to fixing our healthcare system is passing Medicare for All.

energy.text: Garcia proposes reducing emissions through green jobs and technology.
energy.quote: Congressman Garcia's plan to reduce emissions through Green jobs and technology.

voting.text: Garcia said voting should be accessible to every American and endorsed the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act.
voting.quote: I support the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act.

tax.text: Burley advocates tax relief for families and business owners and emphasizes fiscal discipline.
tax.quote: Advocates for tax relief targeted at families and business owners

wages.text: Burley strongly disagrees that government should ensure everyone has a livable income and strongly agrees that free enterprise and private property are essential.
wages.quote:
It is the government’s responsibility to ensure everyone has a livable income.
Strongly Disagree

debt.text: Burley pledges to save, protect, and restore Social Security.
debt.quote: Pledges to work to save, protect, and restore Social Security

safety.text: Burley says he will support law enforcement and protect police funding.
safety.quote: Pledges to fully support and protect law enforcement officers and the military

immigration.text: Supported building a border wall, denying funds to entities that do not comply with immigration laws, and requiring employers to use E-Verify.
immigration.quote: I am in favor of construction of a wall and other necessary infrastructure on our border that gives complete control over entering and exiting the United States.

abortion.text: Said human life begins at conception and supported legal protections for it, along with withholding taxpayer funds from abortion providers.
abortion.quote: Human life begins at conception and deserves legal protection at every stage until natural death.

cannabis.quote: I support the legalization of recreational marijuana. Agree

health.text: Rejected the government responsibility to ensure everyone has health insurance and rejected eliminating private health insurance.
health.quote: It is the government’s responsibility to ensure everyone has health insurance. Strongly Disagree
